upsert.title: Agent Harness on Physical-Engineering's Last Exam (Kaggle × Google)
upsert.summary: Online Kaggle competition hosted with Google: build an open-source agent harness paired with one of eight Google-sponsored models to solve 85 expert-reviewed, long-horizon engineering tasks (structural, civil, electrical, mechanical) from Google Cloud AI Research's Physical-Engineering's Last Exam benchmark. Top 100 qualifying entries advance to 56 hidden test tasks.
upsert.eligibility: Not confirmed. Details taken from an aggregator summary of Kaggle's announcement; check the Kaggle competition rules for age, country and team limits.

prize.description: US$400,000 total prize pool per Kaggle's announcement; per-place split not confirmed.

notes: Found via a Digg summary of Kaggle's X post; the official Kaggle competition page was not opened, so URL points to the Kaggle competitions index and entry status is check. Prize split, timezone and eligibility unverified.
